column3: The offering and sacrifice are combined into one sacrificial offering.
The first statement of verse 14 is appended.
BSB places the first sentence in verse 13.
The debauchery in wine becomes its consequence.
“Hearts” is plural rather than singular; “in” interprets the relation to the heart.
God and Father are joined as God the Father.
BSB supplies “submit,” which the Textus Receptus has (ὑποτάσσεσθε); in the critical text the verb is carried over from verse 21.
The church is explicitly identified as His body.
“Should submit” supplies the verb in the second clause.
